easy.task: Have Wizard Cromperty teleport you to the Rune Essence mine. Note: You can right-click him to teleport.
Steal a cake from the Ardougne market stalls.

Sell Silk to Silk trader[sic] in Ardougne for 60 coins each. Note: You must first offer to sell your silk for 120 coins, then counter his bid with 60 coins. He'll refuse to speak to you if you've just stolen from his silk stall, and his behaviour only resets after you've spent at least ten consecutive minutes outside of Ardougne without logging off.
Use the altar in East Ardougne's church. Note: Requires you to have less than full Prayer points.
Go out fishing on the Fishing Trawler Note: You only have to start this minigame, completing it is optional.
Enter the Combat Training Camp north of W. Ardougne.
Have Tindel Marchant identify a Rusted Sword[sic] for you. Note: There is a 1/100 chance the sword turns out to be nothing, in which case you'll have to bring a new one.
Use the Ardougne Lever to teleport to the Wilderness. Note: You can pull the lever there to return.
View Aleck's Hunter Emporium in Yanille.
Check what pets you have Insured with Probita in Ardougne. Note: You can right-click her to check.

hard.task: Smith an Adamant scimitar in the Resource Area. Note: With 75 Woodcutting and 75 Firemaking, you can bring any axe and a tinderbox to cut and burn some magic logs for an elite task.
hard.requirements: 75 Smithing Hammer and 2 adamantite bars 6,000-7,500 coins

hard.task: Kill a Lava Dragon. Note: Lava dragons are found on Lava Dragon Isle.
hard.requirements: Protection from dragonfire recommended if not safe spotting and weaponry to slay it

hard.task: Kill the Chaos Elemental.
hard.requirements: See the strategy guide

hard.task: Kill the Crazy Arc.[sic], Chaos Fanatic & Scorpia. Note: While these bosses can be killed in any order, completing or updating any other task in-between will reset the progress for this task.
hard.requirements: See the individual strategy guides for the Crazy archaeologist, Chaos Fanatic, and Scorpia

hard.task: Take the agility shortcut from Trollheim into the Wilderness. Note: Not to be confused with the rocky shortcut further north. The shortcut for this task goes in one direction, and cannot be used to leave the Wilderness again.
hard.requirements: 64 Agility Partial completion of Troll Stronghold, or completion of the Easy Combat Achievements for Ghommal's hilt 1

hard.task: Kill a Spiritual warrior in the Wilderness Godwars Dungeon. Note: With 83 Slayer, you can also kill a spiritual mage here to complete an elite task
hard.requirements: 60 Agility or 60 Strength, and 68 Slayer Weaponry and god equipment

hard.task: Fish some Raw Lava Eel in the Wilderness.
hard.requirements: 53 Fishing and 25 Herblore Oily fishing rod, fishing bait Knife, Wilderness sword 1 or 2, or a slashing weapon

elite.task: Kill Callisto, Venenatis & Vet'ion. Note: The lesser versions of these bosses (Artio, Spindel, and Calvar'ion) also count towards this task. You must have claimed the rewards from the hard diary tasks before you can access these lesser bosses. While these bosses can be killed in any order, completing or updating any other task in-between will reset the progress for this task.
elite.requirements: Completion of the Medium Wilderness diary is required to kill the greater versions, and completion of the Hard Wilderness diary is required to kill the lesser versions See the individual strategy guides for Callisto, Venenatis, and Vet'ion, or those for the weaker bosses Artio, Spindel, and Calvar'ion

elite.task: Teleport to Ghorrock.
elite.requirements: Completion of Desert Treasure I 96 Magic Ancient Magicks selected Means to cast Ghorrock Teleport ( 8 2 )

elite.task: Fish and Cook[sic] a Dark Crab in the Resource Area.
elite.requirements: 85 Fishing and 90 Cooking Lobster pot and dark fishing bait 3,750-7,500 coins

elite.task: Smith a rune scimitar from scratch in the Resource Area. Note: You must kill two separate Runite Golems and mine them each for runite ores, smelt two runite bars in the nearby furnace (Superheat Item does not work), then smith the rune scimitar on the anvil. The steps for mining the ores are still completed if the ores are destroyed by an infernal pickaxe. Completing or updating any other task in-between these steps will reset the progress for this task.
elite.requirements: 85 Mining and 90 Smithing Weaponry, any pickaxe, hammer, and 16 coal 3,750-7,500 coins

elite.task: Steal from the Rogues' chest. Note: You must right-click the chest to search for traps. You'll then be attacked by all nearby rogues.
elite.requirements: 84 Thieving

elite.task: Slay a spiritual mage inside the wilderness Godwars Dungeon[sic].
elite.requirements: 60 Agility or 60 Strength, and 83 Slayer Weaponry and god equipment

elite.task: Cut and burn some magic logs in the Resource Area. Note: Logs burnt by an infernal axe do not count towards this task. Logs may also be burnt on the Forester's Campfire. Completing or updating any other task in-between these steps will reset the progress for this task.
elite.requirements: 75 Woodcutting and 75 Firemaking Any axe and tinderbox 3,750-7,500 coins
